method.description: Lexical/rendering divergence indicator; not a doctrinal truth score or majority vote.
method.normalization: case, punctuation, footnote markers, and common KJV archaisms normalized

sources.bsb: Berean Standard Bible (Public Domain / CC0). bereanbible.com.
sources.asv: American Standard Version (1901; Public Domain). ebible.org/asv/.
sources.brenton: Brenton's translation of the Septuagint (1844/1851; Public Domain). ebible.org/eng-Brenton/.
sources.kjv: King James Version, ebible.org 2006 transcription (Public Domain in US).

pob.text: The elder to beloved Gaius[a], whom I love in truth.

spob.text: I, the elder, am writing to my beloved Gaius. I love you in truth.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
public_domain_references.web: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
public_domain_references.asv: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
public_domain_references.kjv: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

pob.text: Beloved[a], I pray that in all respects you may prosper and be healthy[d][c][b], just as your soul prospers.

spob.text: Beloved, I pray that in every way things may go well for you and that you may be healthy, just as your soul is doing well.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
public_domain_references.web: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
public_domain_references.asv: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
public_domain_references.kjv: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

pob.text: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified to your truth[c][b][a], just as you are walking in truth.

spob.text: For I was filled with joy when brothers[a] came and testified about the truth in you,[b] just as you continue to live in the truth.

public_domain_references.bsb: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
public_domain_references.web: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
public_domain_references.asv: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
public_domain_references.kjv: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

pob.text: I have no greater joy than this: to hear that my children are walking in the truth[a][b].

spob.text: Nothing gives me greater joy than hearing that my children[a] are living in the truth.

public_domain_references.bsb: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
public_domain_references.web: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
public_domain_references.asv: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
public_domain_references.kjv: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

pob.text: Beloved[a], you are acting faithfully in whatever you do for the brothers[b], and especially when they are strangers.

spob.text: Dear friend, you act faithfully in everything you do for the brothers,[a] and especially when they are strangers to you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
public_domain_references.web: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
public_domain_references.asv: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
public_domain_references.kjv: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

pob.text: They testified before the church about your love[a], and you will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.

spob.text: They told the church how you showed them love. You will do well to send them on their way[a] in a way that honors God.

public_domain_references.bsb: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
public_domain_references.web: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
public_domain_references.asv: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:
public_domain_references.kjv: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

pob.text: For they went out for the sake of the Name[a], taking nothing from the Gentiles.

spob.text: They set out on their mission for the sake of the Name.[a] They accepted no support from the Gentiles.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
public_domain_references.web: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
public_domain_references.asv: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
public_domain_references.kjv: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

pob.text: Therefore[a], we ought to receive such people[b], so that we may become fellow workers for the truth.

spob.text: So we ought to welcome and support people like them, so that we may become fellow workers for the truth.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
public_domain_references.web: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
public_domain_references.asv: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
public_domain_references.kjv: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

pob.text: I wrote something to the church[a], but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them[b], does not receive us.

spob.text: I wrote something to the church.[a] But Diotrephes loves being the most important person among them, and he does not receive us.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
public_domain_references.web: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
public_domain_references.asv: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
public_domain_references.kjv: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

pob.text: For this reason[a], if I come, I will call attention to the works he is doing, maliciously babbling against us with evil words; and not content with these things, he himself does not receive the brothers[c][b], and he hinders those who want to do so and throws them out of the church.

spob.text: So if I come, I will call attention to what he is doing. He spreads malicious nonsense about us. But he does not stop there. He refuses to welcome the brothers, prevents others from welcoming them, and throws those who are willing to welcome them out of the church.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth [them] out of the church.
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth [them] out of the church.

pob.text: Beloved[a], do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is from God; the one who does evil has not seen God.

spob.text: Beloved, do not copy what is evil. Copy what is good instead. Anyone who does good is from God. Anyone who does evil has not seen God.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
public_domain_references.web: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
public_domain_references.asv: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
public_domain_references.kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

pob.text: Demetrius has received testimony from everyone[a], and from the truth itself. We also testify[b], and you know that our testimony is true.

spob.text: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and the truth itself speaks well of him too.[a] We also testify in his favor, and you know that our testimony is true.

public_domain_references.bsb: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
public_domain_references.web: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
public_domain_references.asv: Demetrius hath the witness of all [men], and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness; and thou knowest that our witness is true.
public_domain_references.kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all [men], and of the truth itself: yea, and we [also] bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

pob.text: I had many things to write to you[a], but I do not want to write to you with ink and pen;

spob.text: I had many things to write to you. But I do not want to write them with ink and pen.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
public_domain_references.web: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
public_domain_references.asv: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write [them] to thee with ink and pen:
public_domain_references.kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

pob.text: But I hope to see you soon[a], and we will speak face to face.

spob.text: But I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.

public_domain_references.bsb: Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send you greetings. Greet each of our friends there by name.
public_domain_references.web: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
public_domain_references.asv: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
public_domain_references.kjv: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] to thee. [Our] friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
